objective.statement: Bring the credits engine to a candidate the owner can launch on mainnet: current intent recorded, every material path traced against it, owner decisions settled, the current source independently reviewed, the full suite, deep invariants and rehearsal valid on the frozen candidate, the runbook exact. The owner sends every mainnet transaction.
objective.authority: Reconstructed by the director on 2026-10-10 from the owner's launch preparation since 2026-10-08 (docs/NEXT.md) and the owner's question of 2026-10-10: 'ok, skip sepolia then. what else needs to be done here?'
boundaries: No mainnet broadcast, deploy, push or merge without an explicit owner instruction.
No launch readiness claim from test counts or checker output.
Phase 2 contracts are named only exitModule and exitToken.

requiredPaths.description: pool skim, FeeRouter flush, payee and protocol legs, Core receive and fee pulls at the five doors
bid rule (drop, climb, ceiling, clamp, rateCap), sellForEth, buyListing and its caller payment, adopt
compose and composeExit with an optional caller payment (0 at launch), statement cost basis and compose time, controller pricing
sellTo through the controller, proceeds split, buyback and burn
exitStatement and its optional caller payment, exit lane, exit token bid and auction, module replacement
settings, setRate, controller, targets, the four Core locks, router owner, handover, rescueCoin, rescueNft
setSuccessor, migrate in batches, the old engine after migrate, successor adopt
config, preflight, deploy, resume, postflight, lock, settings changes after launch
sellers, coin holders, statement buyers, owner payee and backstop composer, protocol, under matched demand and cost ranges

deliverables.description: one maintained reading of current intent with decision provenance
material decisions classified supported, unproved, contradicted or superseded
OD-1 decided and implemented if needed
fresh reviewer on the frozen candidate
full suite and the 7 Deep suites on the frozen candidate
exact release path from a clean checkout of the candidate on the owner's host

ownerDecisions.question: After the first migrate, should the old engine stop buying and composing (retire) or keep every door open (as built)? docs/HANDOFF.md section 4. Decided 2026-10-10: FLOW 48.
When to call coin.lockAllowlist() and router.lock() (NEXT item 19).

Reopened 2026-10-10: the bid follows a rising market in 46 min to 1.25x, 300 min to 2x, 1,100 min to 4x (not 45 min); a seller can drag it down for about 0.3 eth; idleLoosenBps 0 with ceilBps 10_000 parks it. Accept with the corrected table, or change the defaults or bounds? docs/HANDOFF.md section 4. Decided 2026-10-10: FLOW 50, option C.
Should xToBuyback stay in the old engine on migrate, like ethToBuyback? Recommended: yes. Decided 2026-10-10: FLOW 52.
Buyback sandwich once the pool thins: lower the slice setting, or cap each slice by current pool depth in the contract (recommended)? docs/HANDOFF.md section 4. Decided 2026-10-10: FLOW 51, option B.

buyListing: its caller tip is below its gas at launch prices, so third parties will not call it. Keep it (owner keeper use), remove it (smallest attack surface), or raise the tip cap? Decided 2026-10-10: FLOW 57, keep.
